waivers.reason: No fixed ecdsa release is available; JWT uses the cryptography backend. Remove when python-jose no longer resolves ecdsa or a fixed release exists. Renewed 2026-10-01 by owner decision: pip-audit on ecdsa==0.19.2 (latest, 2026-03-26) still reports PYSEC-2026-1325 with no fix version; python-jose 3.5.0 (latest) still requires ecdsa!=0.15.

python-jose <=3.5.0 accepts a DER public key without PEM armor as an HMAC secret (GHSA-3qf3-8w2g-rqmx; incomplete fix for CVE-2024-33663); published 2026-10-05 with no fixed release. Exploitable only when jwt.decode does not restrict algorithms. Measured 2026-10-05 on main@1220689c: every python-jose jwt.decode call passes a single algorithm paired with its key: services/auth/main.py:423,716, services/auth/routers/session.py:191, services/video-processor/main.py:428, services/odoo-bridge/main.py:133, services/local-ai-rag/main.py:588, services/tts-service/main.py:180, and the shared decoder shared/security/access_tokens.py:40 used by services/rag-retrieval/main.py:256 and agents/notification/agent.py:643 (shared/fcm.py:81 only signs with jwt.encode) (RS256 with the public key, otherwise HS256 with the secret), and validate_rsa_key_pair rejects partial RSA configuration at startup. Owner decision 2026-10-05. Remove when a fixed python-jose is released or the services move off python-jose.
